title: Bug: BSD sed non-greedy quantifier in headless-runtime-helper.sh line 49 causes error on macOS
body: Observed in headless-runtime-helper.sh line 49: `sed -E 's|.*[:/]([^/]+/[^/]+?)(\.git)?$|\1|'` fails on macOS BSD sed with 'RE error: repetition-operator operand invalid'. The `?` after `+` (non-greedy) is not supported by BSD sed. The error is suppressed by `|| true` so dispatch continues, but ledger_repo is empty. Fix: replace with `sed -E 's|.*[:/]([^/]+/[^/]+)(\.git)?$|\1|'` (remove non-greedy quantifier) or use `gsed` when available.
